evidence.excerpt: Levenshtein distance has a deeper relationship with coding theory than its familiar modern uses in spelling correction, fuzzy search, or record matching suggest. Vladimir Levenshtein's foundational work studied communication channels in which symbols could be deleted, inserted, or changed. In such channels, the central difficulty is not merely that a symbol can be wrong: insertions and deletions destroy the positional synchronization between transmitted and received sequences.
